verdict: Meta is working; Google is not — and lead intake needs attention.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 37 leads at an average cost of $101.77 per lead — every one of those leads came from Meta, which delivered strong results on $1,831.74 in spend. Google Ads, by contrast, produced only 2 conversions on $1,933.68, a rate that is not sustainable, and budget there is being pulled back accordingly. The week-over-week cost-per-lead drop of nearly 40% is a real gain, though recent daily lead volume has leveled off, so next period should be read as steady rather than accelerating. Separately, your CRM shows 105 open opportunities but no appointments or signed cases logged, which points to a gap in how incoming leads are being followed up — we are working through that intake flow now to close the leak before it costs further ground.

watch_item.fix: Spend is being shifted away from Google and toward Meta, where your cost per lead is proven; Google campaigns are under active review for restructure.
